page.notes: Hebrew letters and vowel points on this scan are blurred and partly obscured by show-through and speckle; forms marked [?] are the likeliest readings, not certain. The running head letters are faint. The grey-smudged band in the left column (around "Kal, pl. m. à f. m." to "Piel, 3. pl.") is legible but low contrast; the Latin is copied as seen. Exod. 10. 3 is printed "io. 3." and left as printed.
